name: Captions
author: kafeijao
description:
Use whisper.cpp to add captions of people's voices into their ChatBoxes.

I would heavily recommend using the model `ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin`. Or any other that says `turbo`, otherwise it might be too slow.

- **Note1:** ⚠️ This is a **__PLUGIN__**, not a Mod
- **Note2:** This is heavy on performance, both processing and Memory

Check [README.md](https://github.com/kafeijao/Kafe_CVR_Mods/tree/master/Captions) for more info.
